description: ICS Village at DEF CON 25 covers Industrial Control Systems security and critical infrastructure protection. The talks explore Modbus vulnerabilities, industrial wireless security, grid insecurity, DFIR for ICS, device-level security, and building automation security.

talks.title: Fun with Modbus 0x5a: Nothing New, Still Relevant?
talks.teaser: Historical analysis of Modbus protocol vulnerabilities and their continued relevance to modern ICS systems.

talks.title: Dissecting Industrial Wireless Implementations
talks.teaser: Analysis of wireless communication implementations in industrial control systems and their security implications.

talks.title: Grid Insecurity and How to Really Fix This
talks.teaser: Critical vulnerabilities in electrical grid infrastructure and practical solutions for improving security and resilience.

talks.title: What's the DFIRence for ICS
talks.teaser: Digital forensics and incident response techniques specific to industrial control systems environments.

talks.title: Cyber Security Issues with Level 0 through 1 Devices
talks.teaser: Security vulnerabilities and threats affecting the lowest levels of industrial control device hierarchies.

talks.title: InSecurity in Building Automation
talks.teaser: Security vulnerabilities and attack vectors in building automation and management systems.
